The '''Mid-Season Invitational''' (also abbreviated as ''MSI'') features the winners from 9 individual Riot leagues spring splits and 4 runner ups from [[LCK]], [[LPL]], [[LEC]], [[LCS]].

==Format==
* '''Qualification'''
** LCK, LPL, LEC, LCS will have 2 slots, while PCS, VCS, LJL, CBLoL, LLA will have 1 slot.
** Each winner from LCK, LPL, LEC (only in Spring), LCS and runner up from LCK (awarded by winning Worlds 2022) will start from Playoffs, while the others start from Play-In.

* '''Play-In''' - ''May 2<sup>nd</sup> - May 7<sup>th</sup>''
** Double Elimination bracket
** All matches (excl. Lower Bracket Final) are played in a {{Abbr/Bo3}}, Lower Final is played in {{Abbr/Bo5}}.
** <span class="bg-up">Top 3 teams</span> qualify to Playoff.

* '''Playoffs''' - ''May 9<sup>th</sup> - May 14<sup>th</sup> and May 16<sup>th</sup> - May 21<sup>st</sup>''
** Three teams from Play-In Stage join five teams with direct entry.
** Double-Elimination bracket
** All matches are {{Abbr/Bo5}}

* '''Patch Information'''
** {{ChampionIcon|Yuumi|20px}} [[Yuumi]] and {{ChampionIcon|Milio|20px}} [[Milio]] are disabled for this tournament due to the ''"New Champions and VGUs must be enabled for playoffs in all four of the top regions in order to be playable at the next international tournament."'' policy.<ref name="yuumi banned">{{cite web|url=https://twitter.com/lolesports/status/1648748727765549056|title=A quick update regarding champion restrictions for #MSI2023|author=LoL Esports|publisher=Twitter|date=2023-04-19|language={{Flag|usuk}}English}}</ref>
